name: Akari Aragaki
source: A strict, frigid teacher who induces fear into troublemakers, Akari is an ordinary human who is still respected by most. She cares for her students, but in the past, being soft on them meant that she was pushed around by others which made her unhappy and turn her into the cold woman she's known to be. In her spare time, her true personality shows.
